verdict.rationale: Real-time multiplayer editing is a fair question for a design tool like Canva, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about simultaneous editing, live cursors, or instant sync. The only collaboration-adjacent items are comments, audit logs, team Brand Templates, and REST APIs that let developers 'sync' designs, which are adjacent features or developer building blocks rather than live multiplayer editing.

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync
